unlisted_practices: Co-designing LLM-based clinical data abstraction tools with clinical researchers
Supporting flexible, user-steerable evaluation strategies for LLM information extraction

screen.reason: The study evaluates how clinical researchers interact with an LLM-based unstructured data abstraction system (Libretto) across cancer research tasks, focusing on usability, workflow barriers, and human-AI interaction gaps rather than testing a specific deployment practice/safeguard comparison.
